name: Ur
overview: The Bible identifies Ur of the Chaldees as the native place of Abraham and his family, including Haran, who died there (Genesis 11:27-28). God called Abraham from this city, bringing him out to inherit the promised land (Genesis 11:31; 15:7; Nehemiah 9:7). Additionally, Ur is noted as the name of a father of one of David's mighty men, linking the name to significant biblical figures beyond Abraham's story (1 Chronicles 11:35). This highlights Ur as both a geographical and genealogical landmark in God's unfolding plan.
